title: Hold each follower translation command for the training minimum
summary: The waypoint follower now keeps a chosen translation entry for 2 s, the shortest hold the policy saw in training, before it chooses the bearing and speed again. Reaching a goal or tripping the heading gate ends a hold at once. Without the hold, a goal near a 22.5 degree bearing boundary made the follower alternate between two neighbouring bank entries every tick: on the staircase route 1,206 of 1,214 translation segments were one tick long, and on a goal at 22.4 degrees 409 of 410. With the hold both routes complete with no one-tick segment. A new test asserts the hold on three routes and reproduces the defect with the hold disabled.
next: Review and merge the bank-conforming follower after green CI; measure the policy's yaw drift while translating before relying on the heading gate.
reason: The change alters the navigation example and its CPU tests. Runtime locomotion sources, checkpoint bytes, the approved robot, acceptance gates and roadmap markers remain unchanged.
